_comment: Pure white-space research for the Denmark region. Each institution here was checked against every Danish-realm Elsevier Pure portal (14 found, listed in _method.portals) plus its own domain and a <slug>.elsevierpure.com lookup, and showed no Pure tenancy. Contacts are the people who hold research-information budget or influence: rectors/CEOs, research directors, library and research-support leads, data/IT leadership and AI teams. emailStatus 'published' = the address is printed on the cited page; 'constructed' = built from the institution's visible address pattern and NOT yet verified. Extend via scripts/discover-staff.js, which now carries these institutions in data/staff-sources.json.

_method.universe: OpenAlex institutions in DK/GL/FO (726 distinct), filtered to 194 non-company organisations with >=200 indexed works.
portals: adk.elsevierpure.com (Royal Danish Academy + Design School Kolding + Aarhus School of Architecture)
_method.negativeTest: 4,828 organisation names were enumerated across those portals via each portal's /en/organisations/?format=rss feed and matched against every candidate name and OpenAlex alias; a candidate also had to have no resolving <slug>.elsevierpure.com host.
_method.ruledOut: NFA (nfa.elsevierpure.com) and GEUS (pub.geus.dk) were on the draft list until the hosted-tenant check found live Pure instances - both are customers, not white space. University of the Faroe Islands, Rigsarkivet, Moesgaard Museum, Naturhistorisk Museum Aarhus and Kong Christian X's Gigthospital were likewise removed after they turned up inside a consortium portal.

ssi.evidence: No org match on any of the 14 portals; ssi.elsevierpure.com does not resolve.
ssi.why: Denmark's largest non-university research producer with no CRIS at all. National infectious-disease preparedness plus a very large publication and biobank output, currently unmanaged.

contacts.name: Anne-Marie Vangsted
contacts.title: Faglig direktor, Biobank, Medfodte Sygdomme & Vaccineberedskab

danishcancersociety.evidence: No org match on any portal; cancer.elsevierpure.com does not resolve.
danishcancersociety.why: Runs its own Center for Kraeftforskning with a large epidemiological output and its own grant programme - a funder and a publisher at once, so both reporting and grant-tracking are in scope.

regionmidt.evidence: No portal; rm.elsevierpure.com and regionmidtjylland.elsevierpure.com do not resolve; forskning.rm.dk is a CMS page, not a CRIS.
regionmidt.why: Two of Denmark's five regions (Hovedstaden, Sjaelland) already run their own regional Pure. Region Midtjylland does not - its hospitals outside Aarhus UH (Hospitalsenhed Midt, Hospitalsenheden Vest, Horsens, Randers) have no institutional research registry. Direct peer precedent to sell against.

regionsyd.evidence: No portal; regionsyddanmark.elsevierpure.com / rsyd.elsevierpure.com do not resolve. SDU's Pure carries OUH and Sygehus Lillebaelt units, but the region itself has no tenancy.
regionsyd.why: Same regional-Pure precedent as Midtjylland. Kvalitet og Forskning already runs the region's research support and the LMS-Syd research leadership forum with SDU - an owner already exists for the system.

regionnord.evidence: No portal; rn.elsevierpure.com / regionnordjylland.elsevierpure.com do not resolve. AAU's VBN carries Aalborg UH units; the region has no tenancy.
regionnord.why: Third region without Pure. Anne Bukh's brief explicitly covers research and university collaboration, so the buying centre is unusually easy to identify.

contacts.name: Anne Bukh
contacts.title: Koncerndirektor - ansvar for forskning og universitetssamarbejde

dmi.evidence: No org match on any portal; dmi.elsevierpure.com does not resolve.
dmi.why: National climate and meteorological research, including Nationalt Center for Klimaforskning. Already has a named Data og Digitalisering department - an existing owner for a CRIS.

dti.evidence: No portal; dti.elsevierpure.com and teknologisk.elsevierpure.com do not resolve.
dti.why: Largest Danish GTS institute. Contract research across five divisions with no institutional publication registry - reporting to the GTS performance contract is manual.

gnaturinstitut.evidence: No Greenland Pure portal exists (pure.gl does not resolve) and no org match on any Danish or Faroese portal.
gnaturinstitut.why: Greenland's principal research institute - fisheries, wildlife and the Greenland Climate Research Centre. The Faroe Islands solved the same problem with a single national Pure consortium (pure.fo); Greenland has no equivalent.

ilisimatusarfik.evidence: No Greenland Pure portal (pure.gl does not resolve); not listed on any Danish or Faroese portal. uni.gl runs a manual 'Opret publikation' web form instead.
ilisimatusarfik.why: A national university registering publications through a web form. The clearest greenfield university left in the Danish realm, and a natural anchor tenant for a Greenland consortium mirroring pure.fo.

dhi.evidence: No portal; dhi.elsevierpure.com and dhigroup.elsevierpure.com do not resolve.
dhi.why: GTS institute for water and environment with roughly a thousand staff and a sustained peer-reviewed output across international offices - no central registry of it.

nationalbanken.evidence: No portal; nationalbanken.elsevierpure.com does not resolve.
nationalbanken.why: Publishes a substantial working-paper and economic-research series through Economics and Monetary Policy, with no research-output system behind it.

contacts.name: Thomas Harr
contacts.title: Assistant Governor & Head of Economics and Monetary Policy

contacts.name: Christian Kettel Thomsen
contacts.title: Formand for direktionen (Chairman, Board of Governors)

fak.evidence: pure.fak.dk serves a default nginx page; research.fak.dk redirects to /esploro/ - a live Ex Libris Esploro instance.
fak.why: Displacement rather than greenfield: they have already bought the idea of a CRIS and chose a competitor. Every other Danish defence- and security-research producer sits in a Pure portal.

contacts.name: Vilhelm Holsting
contacts.title: Institutchef, Institut for Ledelse og Organisation

asiaq.evidence: No Greenland Pure portal; asiaq.elsevierpure.com does not resolve.
asiaq.why: Greenland's survey and environmental-monitoring agency. The OpenAlex count is inflated by dataset records, but the underlying monitoring output is real and entirely unregistered.

cifs.evidence: No portal; cifs.elsevierpure.com does not resolve.
cifs.why: Independent think tank with a member-funded research programme and a UNESCO chair - publishes steadily with no institutional registry.

atv.evidence: No portal; atv.elsevierpure.com does not resolve.
atv.why: The Danish academy of technical sciences: a convening body whose praesidium is drawn from the rectors and R&D directors of institutions that already run Pure. Low seat count, high referral value.

contacts.name: Marianne Thellersen
contacts.title: Praesidiemedlem - koncerndirektor for Innovation og Entreprenorskab, DTU

humanrights.evidence: No portal; humanrights.elsevierpure.com does not resolve.
humanrights.why: Denmark's national human-rights institution has a standing Director of Research and a formal research programme - a named research owner with no system underneath.

bii.evidence: No portal; bii.elsevierpure.com does not resolve.
bii.why: Novo Nordisk Foundation-funded life-science incubator. Its sister NNF centres (CBMR, CPR, reNEW, Biosustain) all report through a university Pure; BII sits outside that and reports to the same funder.

contacts.name: Trine Bartholdy
contacts.title: Chief Business Officer for Life Science

force.evidence: No portal; force.elsevierpure.com and forcetechnology.elsevierpure.com do not resolve.
force.why: GTS institute with a formal R&D obligation under its performance contract and no publication registry to evidence it.

dkdm.evidence: Not on adk.elsevierpure.com (which carries Royal Danish Academy, Design School Kolding and Aarhus School of Architecture) nor pure.kb.dk; musikkons.elsevierpure.com does not resolve.
dkdm.why: The strongest precedent play in the region: Denmark's architecture, design and conservation schools share one artistic-research Pure portal, and the performing-arts conservatories were simply never brought onto it.

nikkb.evidence: No portal; nikkb.elsevierpure.com does not resolve.
nikkb.why: Nordic knowledge centre for chiropractic sitting beside SDU, whose own Pure carries comparable clinical institutes.

drc.evidence: No portal; drc.elsevierpure.com does not resolve.
drc.why: Denmark's largest humanitarian NGO, producing evaluation and applied research at scale for institutional donors who increasingly ask for structured outputs.

dfm.evidence: No portal; dfm.elsevierpure.com does not resolve; dfm.dk/publikationer is a hand-maintained CMS list.
dfm.why: Denmark's national metrology institute. Small but publication-dense, and its peer NMIs across Europe run CRIS systems.

ek.evidence: Not on UC Viden (which carries the professionshojskoler); kea.elsevierpure.com and ek.elsevierpure.com do not resolve.
ek.why: The professionshojskoler share UC Viden; the erhvervsakademier have the same statutory applied-research duty and no equivalent. A consortium-shaped opening, not a single seat.

dignity.evidence: No portal; dignity.elsevierpure.com does not resolve.
dignity.why: Research-active NGO with a clinical and documentation research programme and long-standing university co-authorship.

dbi.evidence: No portal; dbi.elsevierpure.com and brandogsikring.elsevierpure.com do not resolve.
dbi.why: GTS institute for fire and security with a visible forskning-og-udvikling programme and no registry behind it.
